Hand-maintained and small on purpose. Ownership rules come ONLY from CANONICAL_DATA_OWNERSHIP_AUDIT.md / CANONICAL_CONTRACT_CI_SPEC.md — do not invent new ones.
$todo_editorfields_duplication: KNOWN DEBT (do NOT refactor in Phase 2): editorFields here duplicate module_registry/BUILT_IN_MODULES. Class 4 checks they agree, but both must be re-synced by hand when the DB registry changes. Eventual direction: runtime/editor vocabulary -> snapshot/registry -> architectural overlay (this file: class/ownership/deprecations/forbidden only, NOT re-listing editorFields) -> CI. Deferred to a later phase.
$baseline_note: Phase 3: only NEW (non-baseline) COMPETING_SOURCE and RENDERER_ONLY findings block CI. Each baseline entry is a narrow, dated, owned exception naming the exact module+field+class — NOT an ignore-all. Editing this list is a deliberate, reviewable diff; a new violation cannot be silenced by a drive-by edit without review.

overview.note: OverviewSummary reads summary + prose fallback. content/description are read-only fallbacks, not editor fields. examMode/frequency/etc are legacy import keys not read by the exam renderer.

eligibility.note: CANONICAL VALUE = exam_editions.eligibility column (rendered by EligibilitySummary on the main page). The module ALSO has an editorial render surface: the ContentModulesBlock eligibility branch on bespoke CT/tab pages renders qualification/ageLimit/nationality/additionalCriteria. This does NOT make the module canonical — it is an editorial/rendering surface whose structured domain value is owned by the column. 'attempts' is editor-only (not rendered).

important-dates.note: Auto passthrough mirror of the canonical column (dataBindingService.generateImportantDatesAuto). Not independently authored. Frontend renders the column via ImportantDatesSummary.

result.note: Own editorial module; no column duplicate. ResultModule renders declarationDate/checkLink/statistics + prose fallback.

admit-card.note: Own editorial module; no column duplicate. AdmitCardModule renders releaseDate/downloadLink/documents + prose fallback.

exam-pattern.note: Flat live shape rendered on the syllabus tab (ExamPatternModule). The richer papers[] shape in the decorative src/config/moduleRegistry.ts is NOT the contract.

forbiddenFields.reason: The canonical vacancy total lives in exam_editions.vacancy. totalPosts must NOT carry the total (GDS conflict: module 555 vs column 44228). Not rendered today; do not build a renderer for it.

vacancy-details.note: Module is not enabled/rendered for the exam pages. Breakdown fields (categories) belong to the dormant entity_vacancy (NOT committed). Kept LEGACY so a new totalPosts write is a Class-6 finding.

syllabus.note: The rendered syllabus is exclusively the relational exam_syllabus_subjects table (SyllabusSection). This content_modules.syllabus store is unread/deprecated; do not add a reader.

intentionallyUnrendered.reason: Editorial action link; currently unread by the exam frontend (render-or-deprecate is a WAIT item). Distinct from exams.official_website.
